revenue_forecast.name: DecisionSimulator-RevenueForecast-v1
limitations: XGBRegressor is NOT the best-performing model on raw MAE/RMSE; Ridge regression achieved lower RMSE ($5,255 vs $6,748) and higher R² (0.8745 vs 0.7931), and Naive Persistence achieved lower MAE due to strong monthly autoregression ($2,681 vs $3,499).
Forecasts represent correlational projections conditioned on current state, NOT guaranteed causal intervention outcomes.
Forecast horizon is strictly 1 calendar month forward.
revenue_forecast.serving_recommendation: Use hybrid prediction: preserve current MRR baseline and apply model-predicted delta.

churn_risk.name: DecisionSimulator-ChurnRisk-v1
limitations: Event class imbalance (~9.4% base rate) limits single-month recall in out-of-time splits.
Model signals probability of subscription contraction or churn, not guaranteed customer loss.
churn_risk.serving_recommendation: Use as an early warning probability score alongside usage metrics.

startup_survival.name: DecisionSimulator-StartupSurvival-v1
startup_survival.dataset: Startup & Founder Survival Master Dataset (48,000 records)
limitations: XGBoost is the best-performing tested classifier with ROC-AUC ~0.682 and Brier score 0.2044; it provides a probabilistic risk assessment, not deterministic certainty.
Features represent Stage 0 (Day-0 / Pre-Seed) observation point. Post-hoc variables (lifespan, total capital raised, failure reason) are strictly excluded to avoid leakage.
Dataset is procedurally generated and calibrated to aggregate US BLS and CB Insights survival statistics.
startup_survival.serving_recommendation: Use as a scenario sensitivity risk index for runway, burn rate, and customer validation.
